caseIdRule.slotOrder: Within each creator 24 IDs allocate strata in protocol corpus.primaryStrata order repeating byCreator count; replacement keeps assigned ID/stratum and original creator role.
caseIdRule.generationOrder: ascending case ID; no reorder after cases exist

creatorEligibility.rules: protocol.json aiSessions; no prior outcome or exclusion access

creatorBrief.source: frozen corpus-generation contract in protocol.json; custodian extracts only workload taxonomy, input schema, assigned stratum counts, length/orthogonal quotas, and synthetic-only requirement

custody.creatorWorkspace: one isolated creator workspace and conversation per creator; no repository outcome access or peer-draft access
custody.creatorSubmission: append-only private custodian intake; preserve exact UTF-8 source/objective bytes, draft hash, creator slot, attempt, submission timestamp and sanitized brief hash
custody.screening: independent custodian executes frozen lexical and semantic exclusion procedure; creators receive only REPLACE plus a generic reason category, never excluded text or another creator's draft
custody.preCorpusLockReplacement: reject hash and reason preserved; same creator slot, case ID and primary stratum; quotas rechecked; no post-lock replacement
custody.caseLock: after all 48 pass freshness and quotas, freeze exact source/objective bytes, provenance, tags, screen result, case hash and manifest hash; exclusive write and hash verification
custody.postLockOverlap: invalidate confirmatory corpus, no case replacement

creators: own assigned drafts and generic replace dispositions
freshnessCustodian: all draft source/objective and private provenance
executionOperators: frozen execution contracts after pre-output lock

inputAdmission: Before acceptance run assertCaseInputExact(source, objective) from scripts/astra-control-execution-bindings.ts; reject any schema/trim transformation instead of normalizing. Preserve exact submitted bytes.

coverageAllocation.wordCount: count maximal Unicode letter-or-number runs with frozen freshness tokens(source); apostrophes/hyphens separate tokens
